convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iMA x4, iVolumes). Simple single-value signal (GO) for entry/exit. Fixed or percentage-based position sizing. Trade library (CTrade) is standard MT5 and trivially replicable in Python. No custom indicators, no complex multi-timeframe logic, no hedging/grid/martingale.

other_exits: Close buy when GO < OpenLevel - CloseLevelDif

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If Lots > 0, use fixed Lots value. If Lots == 0, calculate as: (FreeMargin * MaximumRisk / 1000.0), then normalize to symbol volume step/min/max constraints.

custom_logic_notes: Entry also requires !CloseBuy for longs and !CloseSell for shorts to prevent immediate re-entry on close signal. The GO formula simplifies algebraically to: GO = (3*C - 3*O)*V = 3*(C-O)*V, making the (H-O), (L-O), (C-L), (C-H) terms cancel out. Deviation is set to spread*3 points. StopLoss and TakeProfit input params exist but are both hardcoded to 0 (no SL/TP by default). SL/TP functions exist but are never effectively used. The Sell entry incorrectly calls SolveBuySL and SolveBuyTP instead of SolveSellSL and SolveSellTP — this is a bug in the original code.
python_conversion_notes: 1) GO formula simplifies to 3*(MA_Close - MA_Open)*Volume — the extra terms cancel algebraically. Verify this simplification matches original behavior. 2) BUG in original: Sell entry uses SolveBuySL/SolveBuyTP instead of SolveSellSL/SolveSellTP — decide whether to replicate the bug or fix it. 3) Standard MT5 Trade/*.mqh libraries map directly to MetaTrader5 Python package functions. 4) Position gate is no_position (only enters when flat). 5) New bar guard uses CopyTime comparison — implement via bar timestamp tracking. 6) Volume type (VOLUME_TICK vs VOLUME_REAL) affects GO values significantly in backtest — must respect VolVolume input parameter.
